Name: Elkanah, Next to the King
Summary: Elkanah, next to the king, was slain by Zichri of Ephraim in Pekah's invasion of Judah.
KeyStory: Zichri slew Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the governor of the house, and Elkanah that was next to the king.
LifeLesson: Standing next to a king is no protection when judgment falls.
